review: Since you clicked on this review (at least at the time of Le Noir Ryo’s release) to find out why she is ranked so low, even though your favourite PM CC says she's a broken Charge meta redefiner or something like that. We will be straight to the point. What does she even do? Tank? There is no reason to look for tanking in the endgame. Damage? Her damage is worse than Season 4 IDs (looking at you, Multicrack Faust), and while her “status per rotation” infliction looks promising on paper, she fails to deliver it at a reasonable speed. (refer to LCCB Ishmael to what reasonable speed is(2 turns vs 6 turns)). So let’s look closer at the “pinnacle of Charge”.Starting with her unique effects: - Le Noir: Gabardine Overcoat - Her starting “defense stance”, in which she spends her first 3 turns, and then every 3-4 turns after using S3-2.
